info.li: Single-nucleus RNA-seq (snRNA-seq) atlas of early Arabidopsis thaliana (Col-0) seed development at 3, 5, and 7 days after pollination (DAP), profiling embryo, endosperm, seed coat, and unfertilized ovule/funiculus nuclei (10x Genomics, two biological replicates per timepoint, 7 libraries total; one 3DAP replicate was split across two reactions, giving rep1a/rep1b).
Results from Martin, Cogdill, Pusey & Gehring (2026) Nature Plants 12:1133–1149. DOI: 10.1038/s41477-026-02295-8. Raw data and processed count matrices: GEO accession GSE295007.

Control: as with the other Lee/Martin-style relative views in this tool, there is no single biological control sample — the relative (log₂ ratio) view is centred on the median of all displayed cell-type pseudobulk means for a given gene, matching the existing expression_to_color_relative(median_ctrl, ...) convention already used for this dataset. Med_CTRL is therefore a synthetic placeholder representing that computed median, not a real GSM sample, following the same convention as the supplied sugarcane example file.

Tissue ids below are the literal, verbatim id attributes from at_seed_template_martin.svg (e.g. 5DAP ii1', including the embedded DAP prefix and the apostrophe in ii1′) — confirmed against the SVG with no synthetic/compound keys.

Cell-type groups are organized by the paper's own L1 tissue-system hierarchy (Fig. 1b,e): Embryo, Endosperm, Seed coat, and Unfertilized ovule and funiculus. Within each L1 group, individual tissue entries are the dataset's L2 annotations (e.g. CZE, MCE, PEN within Endosperm; ii1/ii1′/ii2/oi1/oi2/CPT/CZSC within Seed coat), harmonized across DAP timepoints per the paper's methods.

Note: this SVG template only draws 17 of the L2 annotations described in the paper (not the full per-timepoint L2/L3 catalog) — for example, there is no 7DAP embryo or 7DAP seed coat subtype group, and 5DAP does not separately resolve CZE/MCE/PEN even though the paper text discusses "5 DAP MCE" extensively (Fig. 3e). This view appears to be a curated representative snapshot per timepoint rather than an exhaustive cluster catalog; please confirm with Nicholas/the BAR team whether additional SVG regions should be added for completeness.

Sample replicate assignment per timepoint, from GSE295007: 3DAP = GSM8939988 (rep1a), GSM8939989 (rep1b), GSM8939990 (rep2); 5DAP = GSM8939991 (rep1), GSM8939992 (rep2); 7DAP = GSM8939993 (rep1), GSM8939994 (rep2). All cell types within a timepoint share the same set of libraries since cell type is a post-hoc clustering annotation, not a separate sequencing run.
